title: Grow your Bitcoin, the Mirror Trading International Investor Opportunity 1

asr.full_text: Grow your Bitcoin with Mirror Trading International The objective of Mirror Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin Your balance in trade is always in Bitcoin and you earn Bitcoin daily When the price of Bitcoin rises the value of your trading account will go up Mirror Trading International has a sustainable business model trading Forex using advanced intelligence software, with Bitcoin as the base currency. The profitability of Mirror Trading International comes solely from the trading activities. Your full investment goes into your trading accounts. Mirror Trading International, provide you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading, which takes place from Monday to Friday. The trade results are not guaranteed. No trading knowledge is required. To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days. Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system after seven days. Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system after 7 days. In Mirror Trading International there are no membership fees, no subscriptions, no packages, no costs and deductions. Your full Bitcoin payment goes to your trading account. There are no contracts or lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts. And you can withdraw whenever you like. There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours. As long as it's not over a weekend, because then it might take a bit longer. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows. 40% to you, the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to Miro Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses. All income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated, and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements detailing the income from the trades for the day. Your daily trade income is automatically compounded. Your account remains active provided you maintain a minimum balance in trade. The suggested amount is $100 in Bitcoin. Providing you with a passive sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of mirror trading international. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity and as a member you will earn from the daily trading activities and grow your Bitcoin.

textual.observation: The source promotes passive Bitcoin income from daily trading and asks viewers to register with a Bitcoin wallet and fund an account with a suggested minimum of $100 in Bitcoin.

evidence.quote: Mirror Trading International, provide you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading
To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum.

textual.context: Promotional opportunity; the source describes both the promised income and the registration and Bitcoin-funding steps.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised passive return is directly linked to registering with a Bitcoin wallet and transferring a suggested minimum amount of Bitcoin.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the trading activity, income, company, or wallet transactions are genuine or whether anyone experienced a loss.

textual.observation: The source claims that profits from successful daily trades are allocated partly to the member and partly to the trading system, administration, referral bonuses, and binary profit-sharing bonuses.

evidence.quote: Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows. 40% to you, the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to Miro Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses.

textual.context: The allocation is presented as part of the promoted trading opportunity. The records do not state whether viewers are separately asked to recruit others.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed member return is connected to a stated allocation structure that includes referral and binary profit-sharing components.
textual.limitations: The source does not explain how referral eligibility works, whether recruitment is required, or whether the stated percentages reflect actual payments.

textual.observation: The source promises that withdrawal requests will be sent to the viewer's Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours, subject to a weekend qualification, and states that withdrawals can be made in full or partial amounts.

evidence.quote: You can withdraw in full or partial amounts. And you can withdraw whenever you like. There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours.
not over a weekend, because then it might take a bit longer.

textual.context: Promotional withdrawal and timing claims, with an explicit weekend qualification.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised withdrawal destination and timeframe are tied to the Bitcoin account and the promoted investment activity.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether withdrawals were processed, whether additional conditions existed, or whether the stated timeframe was met.

visual.observation: The presentation states that viewers need a Bitcoin wallet, registration with MTI, a suggested minimum of $100 in Bitcoin, and funding within 7 days.
visual.context: Presented as an onboarding or participation requirement for Mirror Trading International.
visual.potential_relevance: A requested wallet setup, registration, and Bitcoin funding amount are directly linked to access to the described trading service.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish whether registration occurred, whether funds were transferred, or what happened afterward.

visual.observation: The slides promote passive earnings from daily trading and state that no trading experience is required; another slide says viewers can 'GROW YOUR BITCOIN.'
visual.context: The claims appear in branded promotional presentation slides for a Bitcoin trading service.
visual.potential_relevance: Promised or encouraged Bitcoin growth and passive earnings are connected to participation in the described trading arrangement.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish actual profitability, the terms of participation beyond the displayed slides, or whether the claims were fulfilled.

visual.observation: The presentation states that daily trade income is allocated to members and displays a total of 0.9680% for a dated daily trading-income example.
visual.context: The slide presents a dated example and includes the visible qualification, 'Historical results are no guarantee of future results.'
visual.potential_relevance: A numerical trading-income example is used in connection with member returns, which conditionally merits review as a return claim.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish that the displayed figures represent actual or guaranteed payments.

visual.observation: The slides state that withdrawals may be made 'whenever you want' with 'No withdrawal fees/penalties,' and that requests made Monday through Friday are paid within 48 hours into a Bitcoin wallet.
visual.context: These statements are presented as withdrawal terms for the branded trading service.
visual.potential_relevance: Specific access, fee, timing, and Bitcoin-wallet payment claims are linked to the service's promised return process.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show a withdrawal request, a payment, or whether the stated timing and fee terms were met.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source explicitly states that trading results and income are not guaranteed and are subject to positive daily trading results.

evidence.quote: The trade results are not guaranteed.
All income is subject to positive daily trading results.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source claims that the opportunity uses Forex trading with Bitcoin as the base currency and describes the system as automated.

evidence.quote: trading Forex using advanced intelligence software, with Bitcoin as the base currency.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled content consists of branded presentation slides for Mirror Trading International and repeatedly displays the website text 'www.mirrortradinginternational.com'.
The presentation includes a visible qualification that 'Trade results not guaranteed' and separately states, 'Historical results are no guarantee of future results.'

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes passive Bitcoin income through branded Mirror Trading International materials and directs viewers toward MTI registration, a Bitcoin wallet, and a suggested $100 Bitcoin funding amount within seven days. The opportunity advertises growth from daily trading activities and Bitcoin-wallet withdrawals, although the claims are described as non-guaranteed and the records do not establish whether funds or withdrawals were processed.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Viewers are asked to fund a managed trading account with Bitcoin; the presenter links that investment to passive income from trading and automatic compounding. The presenter also says trade results are not guaranteed and income depends on positive results.

evidence.observation: The presenter calls for registration and account funding, with $100 in Bitcoin described as the suggested minimum.
evidence.quote: To get started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days.
